errorRegexLimitReached.message: You can have at most 500 regular expressions in total, counting the URL patterns and exclude patterns of all site groups.
errorRegexLimitReached.description: Regex pattern error: the maximum number of regular expressions across all site groups is reached.

errorRegexBudgetExceeded.message: Together, your regular expressions could make checking a page too slow. Start them with ^, use narrower repeats like [^/]+, or remove some.
errorRegexBudgetExceeded.description: Regex pattern error: the regular expressions of all site groups together exceed the worst-case matching budget.

optionsShortcutsElsewhere.message: This browser can't open its shortcut settings from here. Look for keyboard shortcuts in the browser's own extension settings.
optionsShortcutsElsewhere.description: Settings: shown instead of (or after) Change shortcuts when the browser has no shortcut settings page SiteMark can open, e.g. Safari.

optionsDiagnosticsIncludeOrigins.description: Settings: checkbox, off by default, that adds the origins (e.g. https://example.com/*) of the site groups to the copied diagnostics.
